key_impacts: Reactor plants at Fukushima Daiichi were damaged.
Site entered an emergency situation requiring subsequent stabilization.
Large volumes of contaminated water generated and treated; about 1,100,000 m3 stored on-site as of Oct 2018.
Fuel debris deposits identified in Units 1–3.
evidence_snippets: “Following the accident at TEPCO’s Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Station (NPS) on 11 March 2011”
“addressing the situation of the damaged plants of Fukushima Daiichi”
“As of October 2018, about 1,100,000 m3 of treated water is stored on-site”
missing_information: Human impact details (evacuations, casualties) not provided in the text excerpt.
